_why: RT-3. The upstream never emits NULL; it emits 0. parval=0 on 797 Watauga rows, gisacres=0 on 3,326. Sampled parval=0 rows are government land and HOA common areas — structurally unpurchasable — and parval/gisacres = 0 is the CHEAPEST value in every percentile bucket, so a naive ranking puts them first. Note `owntype` is '' (its only distinct value in Watauga) and `presentval` is empty, so the veto has no structured field except parusedesc — and 'COMMONE' is upstream's misspelling, matched verbatim. saledate 1900-01-01 is -2208988800000 in epoch ms.
